bio: The restored heritage building is home to a lavish restaurant with a high-ceilinged room, crystal chandeliers and scarlet velvet drapes. The concise menu showcases a good selection of Peranakan cooking alongside some vegetarian offerings. Meat lovers may try tamarind glazed grass-fed beef from down under, or the prawn geng curry that can be made vegetarian. Round it out with Markisa semifreddo. Also check out the competitively priced wine list....
